title: RiskVLA-Lite Nexar human action annotation
description: One manually assigned safety action for a Nexar clip at an explicit observation cutoff. Collision labels, BADAS scores, alert times, and model outputs are context, not the action. Official Nexar metadata may be stored under nexar_metadata and must not be used to fill action.

video_id.description: Stable Nexar video id (file stem). Globally unique at dataset revision 7535d0656dac31d7da2846913bb69c6331d2a70a.

collision_label.description: Official Nexar collision/near-collision label. Not an action.

time_of_event.description: Official event time in seconds for positive clips. Null for negative clips. Not an action label.

time_of_alert.description: Official alert time in seconds when present. Not an action label.

observation_cutoff.description: Latest timestamp the annotator was allowed to see. Must be strictly before time_of_event when that time exists.

actionable_from.description: Human timestamp when an intervention first becomes justified. Null when the annotator cannot identify it. Not derived from BADAS.

nexar_metadata.description: Preserved official Nexar metadata. Ignored when reading the action.
